scope: Frozen evaluation after restoring the connector and diffusion transformer from the 256-update,32-pair overfit run. No training performed in this diagnostic.

cohort.interpretation: 48 repeated caption/timestep evaluations across16 target pairs, not48 independent examples; no confidence interval or benchmark accuracy claim.

flow_comparison.native_adapted_diffusion: Original frozen native language conditioner feeding the same adapted DiT used by the PRISM route. This is not a flow-loss measurement of the untouched pretrained DiT.
flow_comparison.prism_raw: Restored PRISM connector with raw caption formatting, feeding the adapted DiT.
flow_comparison.gap_direction: Positive wrong-minus-matched flow MSE favors the correct caption.

paired_input_integrity.runtime_contract: For each record the runner hashes actual DiT noisy inputs and timesteps and asserts equality across native/PRISM and matched/wrong forwards; the report stores the shared post-assertion hashes. The artifact reader does not recompute model activations.

scale_interpretation: Connector output RMS remains smaller than native features, but this is before the pretrained caption RMSNorm; scale alone is not demonstrated to cause the semantic failure.

visual_findings.native_pretrained_cfg5: Original pretrained DiT sampled before joint weights were restored. Both cases contain the requested dog/penguin with blue hats or yellow/blue-tail airplanes.
visual_findings.native_adapted_diffusion_cfg5: Same native conditioner after loading adapted DiT. Both requested object groups remain recognizable; airplane placement differs and full caption fidelity is not established.
visual_findings.prism_raw_native_negative_cfg5: Dog/penguin prompt produces unrelated street or cart-like scene; airplane prompt produces a road vehicle. Neither example contains the requested object group.
visual_findings.prism_raw_cfg1: Dog/penguin prompt produces an unrelated circular object on a line against green background; airplane prompt produces a rear-view road vehicle. Removing mixed-conditioner guidance does not restore semantics in these two cases.
visual_findings.prism_raw_prism_negative_cfg5: Both images become almost uniform saturated purple/blue fields. The raw EOS negative anchor was never trained as unconditional conditioning; this failure does not diagnose PRISM capacity.
visual_findings.rendered_native_column: native_adapted_diffusion, explicitly labeled; original native baseline remains in its separate two sample PNGs.

interpretation: The trained raw route distinguishes matched from wrong captions on the selected training pairs more reliably than on the heldout pairs (23/24 vs13/24 repeated evaluations). This is evidence of some training-set caption sensitivity, not successful visual overfit.

At noisy timestep0.1, native conditioned adapted DiT wins8/8 heldout controls with gap0.06864; PRISM wins3/8 with gap0.00122. The conditioning deficit remains visible while holding the adapted generator fixed.

The two image cases still fail caption semantics under both current mixed CFG5 and CFG1, while native conditioning works with the adapted DiT. The next aligned-connector diagnostic directly tests the representation interface.

There is no evidence here that broad data expansion or PRISM unfreezing alone would solve the issue. This diagnostic does not establish the attainable quality of a correctly aligned frozen PRISM route.
